rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a physical ornamental addition; use the other choices for a gesture or a signature-specific stroke.

example.english: The decorative flourish on this greeting card makes it look much more delicate.
example.traditional: 呢張賀卡加咗啲花邊裝飾，睇落精緻好多。
example.jyutping: ne1 zoeng1 ho6 kaat1 gaa1 zo2 di1 faa1 bin1 zong1 sik1 tai2 lok6 zing1 zi3 hou2 do1

rows.jyutping: cim1 meng2 zeoi3 hau6 go2 jat1 bat1
rows.note: Use this specifically for the decorative stroke at the end of a signature, rather than for a general ornament.

example.english: After signing their name, they added a flourish at the end of their signature.
example.traditional: 佢個名簽完之後，仲加咗簽名最後嗰一筆。
example.jyutping: keoi5 go3 ming4 cim1 jyun4 zi1 hau6 zung6 gaa1 zo2 cim1 meng2 zeoi3 hau6 go2 jat1 bat1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person, place, business, or project that is doing well.

example.english: The company continues to flourish this year, and its business is thriving.
example.traditional: 間公司今年發展得好，生意蒸蒸日上。
example.jyutping: gaan1 gung1 si1 gam1 nin4 faat3 zin2 dak1 hou2 saang1 ji3 zing1 zing1 jat6 soeng5

rows.note: Use this for making broad, forceful movements with an object such as a flag or weapon.

example.english: They flourish the flag on stage to greet the audience.
example.traditional: 佢喺台上揮動旗幟，向觀眾打招呼。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hai2 toi1 soeng5 fai1 dung6 kei4 ci3 hoeng3 gun1 zung3 daa2 ziu1 fu1

rows.note: Use this mainly for plants, crops, or other living things that are growing well.

example.english: With plenty of fertilizer this year, the vegetables flourish.
example.traditional: 今年落足肥，啲菜長得好。
example.jyutping: gam1 nin4 lok6 zuk1 fei4 di1 coi3 coeng4 dak1 hou2

rows.note: Use this when the flourish is a visible dramatic gesture, such as waving a flag, rather than a decoration.

example.english: They made a dramatic flourish with their hands at the most exciting part.
example.traditional: 佢講到最緊張嗰句，突然做咗個誇張手勢。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gong2 dou3 zeoi3 gan2 zoeng1 go2 geoi3 dat6 jin4 zou6 zo2 go3 kwaa1 zoeng1 sau2 sai3
